description.zh: 云南哈尼族人历经1300余年开凿的元阳梯田，随山势蜿蜒起伏，层层叠叠多达3000余层。日出时分，薄雾中的金色水面与天空融为一体，呈现出令人窒息的壮观景象。
description.en: Carved over 1,300 years by the Hani people, Yuanyang's terraces cascade down the mountains in over 3,000 tiers. At sunrise, the mist-shrouded golden water merges with the sky in a breathtaking tableau.

zh: 元阳哈尼梯田，千年稻作文化遗产
日出时金色梯田倒映云海
联合国教科文组织文化景观遗产
en: Yuanyang Hani Rice Terraces, 1,300 years of cultivation
Sunrise over golden terraces reflected in still water

admission.zh: 多依树等观景台联票约100元

tips.zh: 最佳观景时间是11月至次年4月灌水期，日出前1小时到达观景台占位。
tips.en: Best November–April when terraces are flooded. Arrive at the viewpoints at least an hour before sunrise to secure a spot.

description.zh: 丽江古城是纳西族文化的心脏，明清时期的木结构民居沿四方街放射展开，街巷间流淌着清澈的玉河支流。古城完整保存了传统聚落格局与纳西东巴文化，于1997年列入UNESCO世界文化遗产。
description.en: The Old Town of Lijiang is the heart of Naxi culture, where Ming and Qing-dynasty timber dwellings radiate outward from the central Sifang Square, crisscrossed by crystal-clear channels of the Yuhe River. The town preserves an intact traditional settlement layout and living Naxi Dongba culture, inscribed as a UNESCO Cultural World Heritage Site in 1997.

location.en: Gucheng District, Lijiang City, Yunnan Province

zh: 四方街：纳西族传统商贸中心，石板路与水渠纵横交错
东巴文字：世界上现存唯一仍在使用的象形文字系统
en: Sifang Square: the Naxi trading hub, laced with flagstone lanes and water channels
Dongba script: the world's only pictographic writing system still in active use

admission.zh: 古城维护费约80元（进入时收取）
admission.en: Ancient town maintenance fee ~¥80 (collected on entry)

tips.zh: 玉龙雪山距古城约30公里，建议搭配游览；古城夜晚酒吧林立较为嘈杂，可选择住宿在束河古镇更为清静。
tips.en: Jade Dragon Snow Mountain is about 30 km away — pair the two for a full trip. For a quieter stay, consider lodging in nearby Shuhe Ancient Town rather than the busier Lijiang Old Town itself.

description.zh: 怒江、澜沧江（湄公河上游）与金沙江（长江上游）在云南西北部并行奔流逾170公里，其间仅相距66—76公里，是世界上罕见的多江并流地貌。这片面积约1.7万平方公里的保护区涵盖高峡深谷、雪山冰川与热带雨林，是北半球生物多样性最为丰富的区域之一，2003年列入UNESCO世界自然遗产。
description.en: The Nujiang (Salween), Lancang (upper Mekong) and Jinsha (upper Yangtze) rivers run parallel for over 170 km through north-west Yunnan, separated by just 66–76 km — a rare geomorphological phenomenon. This ~17,000 km² protected area spans deep gorges, glaciated peaks and tropical rainforest, making it one of the Northern Hemisphere's most biodiverse regions. Inscribed as a UNESCO Natural World Heritage Site in 2003.

location.zh: 云南省迪庆州、怒江州、丽江市西北部
location.en: Diqing, Nujiang and north-west Lijiang, Yunnan Province

zh: 怒江大峡谷：亚洲最深峡谷之一，垂直落差逾3000米
梅里雪山卡瓦博格峰（海拔6740米），藏传佛教最神圣的雪山之一
2003年列入UNESCO世界自然遗产，涵盖8个地理区域
en: Nujiang Grand Canyon: one of Asia's deepest gorges, vertical relief over 3,000 m
Meili Snow Mountain (Kawa Karpo, 6,740 m): one of the holiest peaks in Tibetan Buddhism
UNESCO Natural World Heritage since 2003, covering 8 geographic clusters

admission.zh: 梅里雪山景区约200元；各分区门票不一
admission.en: Meili Snow Mountain scenic area ~¥200; fees vary by cluster

duration.zh: 3—7天（各分区路途遥远，建议专程深度游）
duration.en: 3–7 days (clusters are far apart; recommended as a dedicated trip)

tips.zh: 德钦县梅里雪山观景台是欣赏日照金山的最佳地点，每年11月至次年3月晴天较多；各区之间需长途驾车或包车，公共交通班次有限。
tips.en: The Deqin viewpoint opposite Meili Snow Mountain is the best spot for the golden 'alpine glow' at sunrise; November–March offers the clearest skies. Inter-cluster travel requires long drives — charter a car as public bus services are limited.

description.zh: 澄江化石地位于云南省玉溪市，保存了约5.2亿年前寒武纪早期的软体动物化石群，是迄今发现的最完整、保真度最高的寒武纪生命大爆发记录地。这里出土了16个动物门类逾196种古生物，为研究动物起源与早期演化提供了无可替代的实证，于2012年列入UNESCO世界自然遗产。
description.en: The Chengjiang Fossil Site near Yuxi, Yunnan, preserves an exceptional assemblage of soft-bodied animals dating to ~520 million years ago — the most complete and faithful record of the Cambrian Explosion ever found. Over 196 species from 16 animal phyla have been recovered here, providing irreplaceable evidence for the origin and early evolution of animal life. Inscribed as a UNESCO Natural World Heritage Site in 2012.

location.zh: 云南省玉溪市澄江市帽天山
location.en: Maotianshan, Chengjiang City, Yuxi, Yunnan Province

zh: 寒武纪生命大爆发最完整化石记录，距今约5.2亿年
196余种古生物，涵盖16个动物门，含多种软体动物原始形态
2012年列入UNESCO世界自然遗产；帽天山化石博物馆实地展示
en: Most complete fossil record of the Cambrian Explosion, ~520 million years old
196+ species from 16 animal phyla, including exceptionally preserved soft-body tissues
UNESCO Natural World Heritage since 2012; Maotianshan Museum showcases finds in situ

admission.zh: 澄江化石地自然博物馆约40元

tips.zh: 澄江距昆明约1小时车程，可与抚仙湖景区合并游览。新建的澄江化石地自然博物馆展陈丰富，适合亲子深度参观。
tips.en: Chengjiang is about 1 hour from Kunming and pairs well with a visit to Fuxian Lake. The newly built Chengjiang Fossil Land Nature Museum has excellent displays — highly recommended for families.

description.zh: 石林是云南省昆明市境内壮观的岩溶地貌奇观，数以千计的灰岩石柱拔地而起，最高可达40余米，宛如一片石化的森林。作为「南方喀斯特」世界遗产的重要组成部分，石林于2007年列入UNESCO世界自然遗产，是彝族撒尼人世代生活的家园。
description.en: Shilin Stone Forest near Kunming, Yunnan, is a breathtaking karst landscape where thousands of limestone pillars — some over 40 m tall — rise from the ground like a petrified forest. A key component of the 'South China Karst' World Heritage Site, it was inscribed by UNESCO as a Natural World Heritage Site in 2007 and is the ancestral home of the Yi people's Sani branch.

location.zh: 云南省昆明市石林彝族自治县
location.en: Shilin Yi Autonomous County, Kunming, Yunnan Province

zh: 数千根灰岩石柱拔地而起，最高逾40米，构成「天下第一奇观」
彝族撒尼人的传统节日「火把节」，每年农历六月二十四日举行
2007年以「南方喀斯特」世界遗产组成部分列入UNESCO
en: Thousands of limestone pillars up to 40 m high — dubbed 'the First Wonder of the World'
Sani Yi Torch Festival (Huoba Jie) held annually on the 24th day of the 6th lunar month
UNESCO Natural World Heritage since 2007 as part of 'South China Karst'

tips.zh: 石林距昆明约90公里，可乘高铁或旅游巴士前往；建议错开节假日，清晨入园人少景色最佳。
tips.en: Shilin is about 90 km from Kunming; high-speed rail or tourist coaches are available. Arrive early in the morning to beat crowds and get the best light.

name.zh: 高黎贡山世界地质公园

description.zh: 高黎贡山世界地质公园位于云南省怒江州，地处青藏高原东南缘，记录了印度板块与欧亚板块碰撞的完整地质历程。园区内海拔跨度超5000米，涵盖热带雨林至高山冰雪带，是北半球纬度最低、生物多样性最丰富的山地之一。
description.en: Gaoligongshan UNESCO Global Geopark in Nujiang, Yunnan, lies on the south-eastern edge of the Tibetan Plateau and preserves a complete geological record of the collision between the Indian and Eurasian plates. With an elevation span exceeding 5,000 m — from tropical rainforest to alpine snowfields — it is among the most biodiverse mountain ranges in the Northern Hemisphere.

location.zh: 云南省怒江傈僳族自治州
location.en: Nujiang Lisu Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

zh: 记录印度—欧亚板块碰撞的完整地质剖面
海拔跨度逾5000米，涵盖热带至高山多个气候带
en: Complete geological cross-section documenting India–Eurasia plate collision
Over 5,000 m elevation range spanning tropical to alpine climate zones

admission.zh: 各景区门票不一，部分区域免费
admission.en: Fees vary by area; some zones are free

tips.zh: 高黎贡山地处边境，部分区域需边境通行证；怒江沿岸公路风景壮丽但弯道多，自驾需谨慎。
tips.en: Some areas near the border require a border pass. The scenic Nujiang riverside road has many sharp curves — drive carefully or hire a local driver.

description.zh: 石林世界地质公园位于云南省昆明市石林彝族自治县，以数千根拔地而起的灰岩石柱著称，最高逾40米。石林地貌形成于约2.7亿年前的古生代海洋，经亿年溶蚀塑造而成，是全球岩溶地貌的标志性代表。2004年加入UNESCO全球地质公园网络，同时也是2007年列入的「南方喀斯特」世界遗产核心区之一。
description.en: Shilin UNESCO Global Geopark in Shilin Yi Autonomous County, Kunming, showcases thousands of towering limestone pillars — some exceeding 40 m in height — sculpted from a Palaeozoic seabed laid down ~270 million years ago. It is a global benchmark of tropical karst geomorphology, admitted to the UNESCO Global Geoparks Network in 2004 and simultaneously forming a core zone of the 'South China Karst' UNESCO World Heritage Site inscribed in 2007.

location.zh: 云南省昆明市石林彝族自治县
location.en: Shilin Yi Autonomous County, Kunming, Yunnan Province

zh: 大石林景区——2.7亿年古生代灰岩石柱群，岩溶地貌全球标杆
阿诗玛石像——彝族撒尼人传说中的美丽化身，园内最著名的石柱景观
UNESCO全球地质公园（2004年）暨「南方喀斯特」世界遗产（2007年）双重认证
en: Big Stone Forest area — Palaeozoic limestone pillars 270 million years in the making, a global karst benchmark
Ashima Rock — the most iconic pillar formation, embodying the Sani Yi legend of the beautiful girl Ashima
UNESCO Global Geopark since 2004 and 'South China Karst' World Heritage since 2007 — dual international recognition

tips.zh: 石林距昆明约90公里，可乘高铁约40分钟至石林站再换乘景区班车。清晨入园游客较少、光线最佳；彝族火把节（农历六月二十四）期间有精彩歌舞表演。
tips.en: Shilin is ~90 km from Kunming; take the high-speed train (~40 min) to Shilin station then a shuttle. Arrive early for smaller crowds and the best light. The Yi Torch Festival (24th day of the 6th lunar month) features spectacular singing and dancing.

name.zh: 普洱景迈山古茶林文化景观
name.en: Pu'er Jingmai Mountain Ancient Tea Forest Cultural Landscape

description.zh: 景迈山古茶林是布朗族与傣族世代相传超过千年的古茶园文化景观，古茶树与传统村寨、森林共生共融，展示了人与自然和谐共存的智慧。遗产区包含五片古茶林（总面积约1180公顷）、九座传统村寨及三片隔离防护林，至今仍有约5000人在此生活耕作。2023年9月列入UNESCO世界遗产名录，是中国第57处世界遗产，也是全球首个茶文化世界遗产。
description.en: Jingmai Mountain's ancient tea gardens have been tended by the Bulang and Dai peoples for over 1,000 years. Five ancient tea forest zones (~1,180 ha), nine traditional villages and three buffer forests coexist in a living cultural landscape that embodies humanity's harmony with nature — around 5,000 people still live and farm here today. Inscribed in September 2023 as China's 57th World Heritage Site and the world's first tea-culture UNESCO inscription.

location.zh: 云南省普洱市澜沧拉祜族自治县
location.en: Lancang Lahu Autonomous County, Pu'er, Yunnan

zh: UNESCO世界遗产（2023年9月），中国第57处，全球首个茶文化世界遗产
五片古茶林逾百万株千年古茶树，至今仍在采制普洱茶
布朗族、傣族传统村寨九座，世代延续的「茶祖信仰」与采茶习俗
en: UNESCO World Heritage Site since September 2023 — China's 57th and the world's first tea-culture inscription
Over one million ancient tea trees across five forest zones, still harvested for Pu'er tea today
Nine traditional Bulang and Dai villages with living 'Tea Ancestor' beliefs and centuries-old cultivation practices

tips.zh: 春茶采摘季（3—4月）是最佳参观时机，可亲历采茶制茶全过程；山路崎岖，建议从澜沧县城包车前往或参加当地团。普洱市区距景迈山约3小时车程。
tips.en: The spring tea harvest (March–April) is the best time to visit — you can join the picking and processing firsthand. Roads are winding; charter a car from Lancang county seat or join a local tour. Allow about 3 hours driving from Pu'er city.

name.en: Dali Cangshan Mountain and Erhai Lake Scenic Spot

description.zh: 苍山洱海位于云南省大理白族自治州，苍山19座山峰与18条溪流绵延横亘，与镜面般的洱海相映成趣，共同构成一幅壮丽的山水画卷。苍山拥有超过6000种植物，垂直植被带从湖畔亚热带林一直延伸至山顶高山草甸与雪山，同时也是白族传统文化与南诏、大理国历史文明的核心地带。该遗址于2001年提交UNESCO世界遗产候选名录，目前仍在审议评估中。
description.en: Cangshan Mountain and Erhai Lake lie in Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, western Yunnan. The 19 peaks and 18 streams of Cangshan rise dramatically above the mirror-like Erhai Lake, forming a sweeping mountain-lake panorama. Cangshan harbours over 6,000 plant species in a pronounced vertical gradient from lakeside subtropical forest to alpine meadow and snowfields. The area is also the heartland of Bai ethnic culture and the ancient Nanzhao and Dali Kingdom civilisations. Submitted to the UNESCO World Heritage tentative list in 2001; evaluation ongoing.

location.zh: 云南省大理白族自治州大理市
location.en: Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan

zh: 苍山19峰逾6000种植物，垂直植被带横跨亚热带至高山雪域
洱海——云南第二大高原淡水湖，湖光山色是大理的标志性景观
UNESCO世界遗产候选地（2001年提名），兼具自然与文化双重价值；大理古城、崇圣寺三塔近在咫尺
en: 19 Cangshan peaks with 6,000+ plant species spanning subtropical to alpine-nival zones
Erhai Lake — Yunnan's second-largest plateau freshwater lake and Dali's iconic landscape centrepiece
UNESCO World Heritage tentative site (nominated 2001) for mixed natural and cultural values; Dali Ancient Town and the Three Pagodas of Chongsheng Temple are nearby

admission.zh: 苍山景区缆车约65—100元；洱海游船约50—200元不等；大理古城免费进入
admission.en: Cangshan cable car ~¥65–100; Erhai Lake boat tours ~¥50–200; Dali Ancient Town is free to enter

duration.en: 2–3 days (including Dali Ancient Town and surroundings)

tips.zh: 洱海骑行（全程约130公里环湖公路）是感受苍山倒影的最佳方式；3—4月杜鹃花开时苍山风景最为绚丽；大理全年气候宜人，但山顶风大，登山需备外套。
tips.en: Cycling the ~130 km lakeside road around Erhai is the best way to take in the Cangshan reflections. Rhododendrons peak in March–April. Dali enjoys pleasant weather year-round, but the mountain ridges are windy — bring a jacket for any hike up Cangshan.
